day_shape: 81 items: US–Iran phased Hormuz-reopening talks reported, UAE suspends Iranian airline flights citing US sanctions, Saudi Arabia/Turkey/Pakistan convene after Houthi strikes on Riyadh and Yanbu, UK pledges £88m Gaza aid and warns Iran over UK-soil activity.

threads.label: Hormuz reopening talks and blockade pressure
threads.summary: Reuters and Iran International reported US–Iran negotiators exploring a phased deal reopening the Strait of Hormuz in exchange for lifting Washington's economic blockade, with Araghchi telling reporters at UNGA Iran had offered a seven-day proposal. Iran International reported Saudi Arabia and the UAE are urging Trump to maintain sanctions and the naval blockade per WSJ; Kepler shipping data cited by IRIB claimed only 10 vessels transited Hormuz yesterday versus a 17-vessel average.

threads.label: UAE suspends Iranian airlines; Tehran threatens neighbours
threads.summary: The UAE's General Civil Aviation Authority suspended all Iranian airline flights to and from the country until further notice, citing US sanctions on Iran's aviation sector. Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, said Tehran would attack airports of neighbouring countries cooperating with the sanctions.

threads.label: Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia; coalition response
threads.summary: Saudi Arabia intercepted six Houthi ballistic missiles aimed at Taif and Yanbu, and the Houthis claimed missile and drone attacks on a "sensitive target" in Riyadh. Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan announced an urgent chiefs-of-staff meeting, and President Macron said France would deploy military resources to Saudi Arabia's Yanbu port to protect energy infrastructure.

threads.label: UK Gaza aid package and Iran warning
threads.summary: The FCDO announced an £88 million UK humanitarian package for Gaza at UNGA, alongside a joint Call to Action on humanitarian access and health with Australia, Denmark, Egypt, Jordan, Kuwait, Qatar and Saudi Arabia. Sky News reported Britain warned Iran it would not tolerate hostile activity on UK soil, and IRIB said Foreign Secretary held talks with Araghchi.

threads.label: Gaza operations and IDF drone incident
threads.summary: The IDF said it destroyed a two-kilometre tunnel in the Israeli-controlled portion of Gaza and killed two Hamas operatives including Jabr Moqbel of the "Moqbel" money exchange network. IDF Chief Eyal Zamir ordered a panel to investigate the deaths of two reservists, Nadav Kali and Ofek Moalem, killed when their explosive drone crashed and detonated.

threads.label: UNGA speeches and post-war diplomacy
threads.summary: Pezeshkian's UNGA speech drew Iranian establishment praise and referenced "not bending the knee"; regime channels highlighted a mass walkout during Netanyahu's speech and listed departing delegations. Lavrov and Araghchi met in New York calling for a diplomatic solution, while bereaved Iranian families disputed Pezeshkian's claim that January protesters were armed by the US and Israel.

threads.label: Israeli posture toward Iran; China supply reporting
threads.summary: Defence Minister Israel Katz said the arrival of the sixth submarine INS Drakon after a 3,792-nautical-mile voyage from Kiel was "a message to Iran," and JPost reported Israeli officials believe resumed strikes on Iran are a matter of time. The Times of Israel, citing WSJ and Iranian customs data, reported China sent around 1,300 air shipments of dual-use drone and missile components to Iran's Defence Ministry through June.
